activity.notes: Vytautas the Great acquired effective grand-ducal authority in Lithuania through the Astrava settlement in 1392 and ruled until his death on 27 October 1430. ATLAS records one continuous Grand Duchy of Lithuania sovereign Activity; his planned royal coronation in 1430 was never completed and therefore does not create a separate kingship.

sources.title: Vytautas Didysis — Visuotinė lietuvių enciklopedija
sources.citation_text: The Universal Lithuanian Encyclopedia identifies Vytautas as Grand Duke of Lithuania, explains his assumption of grand-ducal authority from 1392, and gives his death on 27 October 1430.

sources.title: Grand Duchy of Lithuania from the Union of Kreva to the Union of Lublin — Visuotinė lietuvių enciklopedija
sources.citation_text: The encyclopedia's institutional history gives Vytautas's separate Lithuanian grand-ducal rule as 1392–1430 and explains the restoration of autonomous Lithuanian state institutions.
